calculation: Build 37 x 44 gene-context statuses, count WT/fer4 nominations by cell identity, divide by zones scored in both genotypes for the same gene. Select ten assayed DOFs. A dependency retained in the matrix script also reads the family plotting table for assertions, although it does not determine matrix cells.
prototype_caveats: Descriptive context counts, not replication, TF activity, or a cell-type-only fitted network. Opposite directions can occur in different zones. Original pooled score nominations and missingness are preserved, including unresolved source findings.

calculation: Read all-ten-tissue tested-DOF edges, normalize target symbols where the annotation table supplies them, select IAA/SAUR/GH3/TAA/TAR/YUC names, collapse source-target pairs across contexts/genotypes. Compare pairs with seven-fit reference. 935 source rows ->180 pairs, 10 DOFs, 37 targets; selected edges in 43 contexts/83 genotype-contexts. 147 pairs have seven-fit support, 33 occur only in excluded fits.
prototype_caveats: As-exported descriptive union, not one jointly fitted graph. Includes all known issue classes; support categories do not establish which edges survive corrected fits. Symbol-family filter is not pathway enrichment or complete auxin biology. Positions are geometry only; no activation, repression or intercellular transport inferred.

calculation: Apply same target-symbol family filter, retain elongating phloem-pole pericycle, xylem-pole pericycle and procambium, and union WT/fer4 source-target pairs. 207 source rows ->81 pairs, 10 DOFs and 23 targets in 3 contexts.
